caption: The video showcases a close-up of a hand pinching a three-stone ring between the thumb and two long-nailed fingers. The backdrop is a softly blurred outdoor scene of pavement and grass dappled with shadows. The ring, two smaller round stones flanking a larger center stone on a thin metal band, is tilted toward the sunlight. The fingers slowly rotate and tilt it, so the band loop curving to the right gradually turns and becomes largely hidden behind the fingertips. As the facets shift angle, bright star-like flares and rainbow-colored flashes flicker intermittently across the stones. The hand also drifts slightly within the frame.
